breakdown.description: The prompt sets the torsional shear stress to zero at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. The generated specification correctly includes the torsional shear stress τ = Tc/J in the plane stress state (τₓᵧ = τ), matching the ground truth which uses both the axial stress and the torsional shear stress together in the principal stress calculation. The erroneous instruction to set shear stress to zero was not repeated.
